references.text: The preceding description of the menorah and its decorations with almond blossoms, buds, and flowers, as verse 34 continues to describe.
Parallel text describing the four almond-shaped cups on the lampstand itself with buds and flowers, when Bezalel made the menorah.
The complete description of how the menorah was actually made, with all details about almond blossoms, buds, and flowers.
Describes the design of the menorah as hammered gold from its base to the flowers, in accordance with the pattern shown to Moses by the Lord.
The lampstands of pure gold in Solomon's temple, which were based on the design of the tabernacle's menorah.
Zechariah's vision of a golden lampstand, connecting to the symbolism and meaning of the menorah.
John's vision of seven golden lampstands, building upon the symbolism of the menorah from the tabernacle.
Mentions the lampstand as part of the furnishings in the first room of the tabernacle.
This verse confirms the theological principle of unity and wholeness in holy work by showing that the decoration was integrated with the stem itself.
